ABOUT HARIS NENMARA

“The Game. The Story. The Final Third.”

Haris Nenmara is the face and voice behind FINAL THIRD— a sports platform built for fans who live and breathe the game.

From the passion of football to the excitement of cricket, Haris brings fans closer to the action through match discussions, commentary, insights, and stories that make every moment matter.

For Haris, sport is more than just a scoreline. It is about the emotions, the rivalries, the unforgettable moments, and the millions of fans who make every game special.

FINAL THIRD is where the passion for sport meets the power of storytelling.

Every match has a story. Let's get into it.
